scouting_summary: Paul Skenes profiles as an above-average major-league starter with a deep 6-pitch arsenal. The overall profile includes 92.6 mph average velocity, a 36.9% zone rate, a 38.6% chase rate, a 37.8% hard-hit rate. The Changeup is the strongest bat-missing pitch, producing a 35.5% whiff rate. Command remains the primary area to monitor, but the quality and depth of the arsenal support continued starter value.
